limits: The picture on the screen is generated after the look of the accepted EXOSIGNAL HAIR screen and fitted into the display of the real photo (display corners in the cut-out: 188,42 - 822,58 - 749,502 - 101,444); real captures at x50 and x200 replace it when the owner sends them. The scan itself (K3q) shows the handset in the hand and no system.

K3q.what: the handset on the parting, held correctly
K3q.source: ready: the sample of the EXOSIGNAL HAIR fix, free

S.what: the screen of the system in the left foreground, the handset on the parting behind it
S.prompt:
Reproduce the first reference image exactly - the same screen of the diagnostic system in the left foreground with the same magnified image of the scalp on it, the same silver cylinder base under it, the same two women with the same faces, hair and clothes, the same room, window, plant, light and framing. Change only two things.
1. The white handset in the cosmetologist's hand and its position are exactly as in the second reference image: the same wide curved white body lying almost flat along the top of the patient's head, its head end with the black oval Mitoscan panel resting on the parting, the panel facing up, the cable leaving the opposite end near her wrist. Do not change the handset itself: the same shape and thickness, not thinner, not longer, no cone, no nozzle, nothing added.
2. There are no hair clips in the patient's hair: her hair is simply parted in the middle and held by the same brown headband, as in the second reference image.
Nothing else changes. Photorealistic. No text except the word Mitoscan on the handset panel; no captions, no overlays.
S.verdict: superseded: the system in it is model-drawn (a tablet with a dark bezel) - replaced by Sr with the real system

N.what: the look with the naked eye: both hands part the hair, no device
N.prompt: Reproduce the first reference image exactly - the same two women with the same faces, hair and clothes, the same brown headband, the same room, window, plant, light and framing. Change only this: there is no handset and no cable anywhere in the frame - the cosmetologist's hands are empty. With the gloved fingertips of both hands she gently parts the patient's hair along the parting and looks closely at the scalp with the naked eye, leaning a little closer. The patient sits calm, looking down as before. No device, no instrument, no screen in the frame. Nothing else changes. Photorealistic. No text, no captions.

E.what: the end of the visit: both smile, no device
E.prompt: Reproduce the first reference image exactly - the same two women with the same faces, hair and clothes, the same brown headband, the same room, window, plant, light and framing. Change only this: the examination is finished. There is no handset and no cable anywhere in the frame. The cosmetologist stands in the same place beside the patient, her gloved hands lowered and relaxed, one hand resting lightly on the back of the chair; she looks at the patient with a warm calm smile, explaining. The patient has raised her head and looks up at the cosmetologist with a calm content smile. No device, no instrument, no screen in the frame. Nothing else changes. Photorealistic. No text, no captions.

P1.what: the plate without any device: the cosmetologist points at the empty table in the lower left, the patient looks there
P1.prompt:
Reproduce the first reference image exactly - the same two women with the same faces, hair and clothes, the same brown headband, the same room, window, plant, light and framing. Change only two things.
1. Remove the diagnostic system from the table completely: there is no screen, no silver base, no device at all. The white table top in the lower-left foreground is empty and clean, and behind it the room continues naturally.
2. The cosmetologist no longer holds any handset: there is no handset and no cable anywhere in the frame. She stands in the same place beside the patient and with one gloved hand points down toward the empty place on the table in the lower-left foreground, as if showing something there, looking at that place and explaining. The patient has turned her eyes toward the same place and looks at it with calm interest. Her hair is parted in the middle and held by the brown headband, with no hair clips.
Nothing else changes. Photorealistic. No text, no captions, no devices, no screens, no objects on the table.

SC.what: the flat scan picture for the screen
SC.prompt: The magnified picture of the scalp that is shown on the screen in the reference image - the same pink skin surface with fine flakes, the same dark hair shafts crossing the picture and emerging from the skin, the same soft even lighting of a dermatoscope camera - shown flat and filling the whole frame, sharp and detailed, as the raw picture from the camera at about fifty times magnification. Aspect ratio 16:10. No screen frame, no bezel, no device, no table, no room, no hands, no reflections of a room, no text, no labels, no numbers, no overlays, no arrows.

C1.from_to: N (one start frame, no end frame)
C1.prompt: One continuous shot, no cuts; the camera stays in place with only a barely noticeable drift. The cosmetologist in the white uniform and white gloves examines the patient's scalp with the naked eye: with the gloved fingertips of both hands she gently parts the hair along the parting, moves a little further along it, leans closer and looks carefully; the patient sits calm, looking down, and breathes quietly. Natural small movements, soft daylight. No device, no instrument, no screen appears. No text, no captions.

C2.from_to: K3q (one start frame, no end frame)
C2.prompt: One continuous shot, no cuts; the camera stays in place with only a barely noticeable drift. The cosmetologist slowly glides the white handset along the parting, a few centimetres forward and back, watching closely; the handset stays as it is - lying almost flat on the top of the head, the black oval panel facing up, the cable at her wrist - and does not change its shape. The patient sits calm, looking down, and breathes quietly. Natural small movements, soft daylight. No screen and no other device appear. No text, no captions.

C3.from_to: Sr (one start frame, no end frame)
C3.prompt: One continuous shot, no cuts; the camera stays in place with only a barely noticeable drift. The cosmetologist points at the screen of the diagnostic system on the table and explains, nodding slightly; the patient looks at the screen with interest and then glances up at her. The diagnostic system on the table - its screen with the magnified picture of the scalp, its silver base, the docked white handset and the coiled cable - does not move and does not change in any way. Natural small movements, soft daylight. No text, no captions.
